title: Custom agent
description: agents/<id>.json: a custom agent (§7.2, AG-1). It reaches the semantic model only through its `tools`; its evaluation set is agents/<id>.eval.json (schemas/v1/eval.json). Custom agents are created and run only once the semantic model is Ready (§3). Run history lives in the database, not in this file.

purpose.description: What it answers, in one sentence

instructions.description: Tone, format, rules; Git keeps every version

version.description: Published version; 0 until first published, + 1 on each publish

status.description: Only published agents serve users; any save makes it a draft again

scope.description: Knowledge scope: the IDs it may use

tools.description: The exact tools it may call: custom tool IDs (tools/<id>.json), semantic_query, report_snapshot, and only the action tools send_email, post_message, refresh, propose_edit (DECISIONS D-3)

agents.description: Other published agents of the project it may ask (tool ask_agent): each runs as the asking user with its own scope, tools and grounding, at most two levels deep

mode.description: exploratory may also run read-only semantic queries within the scope

model.description: AG-6: a workspace LLM provider model alias (small, large, …; list_llm_providers) or auto (large for build/change or long questions, small otherwise)

effort.description: AG-6/D-71: reasoning effort for its runs and flow steps, sent only where the model lists the level (ChatGPT plan models, provider aliases with declared efforts); omitted: the user's ChatGPT effort or the alias default

grounding.description: Check every number and entity name against tool results (AG-2); required (true) for any channel other than in_app

channel.description: Slack: the channel ID a slash command comes from (C0123ABCD; a DM gives its D… ID), never a name; Teams: the channel ID an @mention of the outgoing webhook comes from (channelData.channel.id, 19:…@thread.tacv2)

reply.description: Teams: the project's settings.delivery.channels entry (type teams) the answer is posted to; an outgoing webhook can't answer later in its reply chain (DECISIONS D-32)

channels.description: Where it can be reached; stored only, delivery is AG-5

owner.description: User ID of the person who last saved it

sharing.description: SH-1 (D-51): "project" = everyone with a role in the project; or also view-only runs for accounts with no role there. Changed with action set_sharing; project members always see it

users.description: User IDs of named recipients (their tenant must match the project, checked when they run it)

workspace.description: Every account of the project's tenant (platform project: every platform account)

examples.name: Supply Chain Assistant
examples.instructions: Answer questions about materials, stock and consumption. Use tools for every number.
